query:
UPDATE till_users SET failed_pins = 0
           WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND id = $3
             AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= now())
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM till_registers
                         WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND id = $2
                           AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= now()))
           RETURNING true AS "ok!"
